rawMessage: In multi-icon solutions across all HPE products, OCA CLIC validation attributes child container/chassis service and configuration errors to Item 0100/01 (the first line in the solution tree, Rule 81039677) regardless of where the error actually resides. Never assume the first line is the root cause; inspect child icon containers directly.
ruleUpdate: When Rule 81039677 occurs on multi-icon tenders, trace errors to individual child icon containers instead of modifying the root BOM item.
scopeEvidence: Vendor-wide across all HPE multi-tier configurations (ProLiant + Synergy + Alletra + Cray).

rawMessage: Across all HPE configurations mixing rack servers (DL380) with modular chassis (Synergy frames) or storage (Alletra), NEVER check 'Apply to all icons inside solution' for support or deployment services. Support tiers must be established independently per icon to prevent chassis-level support options from corrupting server containers.
ruleUpdate: Configure support services independently per icon container. Never broadcast support attributes across diverse product families.
scopeEvidence: Vendor-wide across all HPE multi-tier solutions.

rawMessage: When WebLogic OCA gets stuck in contradictory or persistent service rule errors after modifying service lines, the backend pricing/rule engine has a stale session cache. Setting Support to 'No Support' / 'No Installation' and clicking Check flushes the corrupted backend rule cache, allowing clean re-application of the desired support tier with auto-balanced quantities.
ruleUpdate: Flush corrupted OCA support session state by toggling to 'No Support' before reapplying 3Y Tech Care Basic.
scopeEvidence: Vendor-wide across all HPE OCA configuration sessions.
